answer_1.quote: Report Generation ... requires the model to generate two key sections of a typical report ... We also evaluate VividMed on image captioning ... using the ROCOv2 dataset.
answer_1.outputs: radiology reports, grounded reports, image captions, VQA answers

answer_2.quote: We employ BLEU-1 and ROUGE-1 as evaluation metrics ... we also utilize CheXpert F1, CheXbert vector similarity, RadGraph F1, RadCliQ, RadBERT F1, etc.

answer_3.quote: we additionally utilize Llama 3 70B to evaluate accuracy.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a qualitative review for grounded reports generated by VividMed on 12 selected cases ... Among 91 generated sentences, 82 can be accepted as-is, 9 are wrongly stated and need major correction.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters assessed each generated sentence for correctness and grounding accuracy.
